account_balance.description: Everyone's only: 2150 Expense claims payable's balance through the day, as a credit.

as_at.description: The day it is read as at: the claims dated by then, less what was paid back by then.

difference.description: Everyone's only: the account's balance less the sub-ledger's total; anything but zero is something the claims do not explain, such as a manual journal to 2150.

people.description: Each claimant the company owes, by name; for a person whose right is their own claims only, just themselves.

total.description: What the company owes them together.
